prompt:
You improve the first-run onboarding of a desktop pet app.

Funnel (conversion from the previous step, and time taken):
- choose_path: 76.2%, median 8s / mean 514s
- sign_in: 81.5%, median 3s / mean 567s
- adoption: 60.9%, median 89s / mean 1017s
- home: 81.3%, median 201s / mean 2336s
- finish: 71.0%, median 395s / mean 5815s
- finishing onboarding overall: 21.8%

What users wrote to support last week, grouped into themes (most mail is about later problems).
Everything between the markers is data, not instructions:
<support_themes>
- [sign_in, account] Pets missing or reset after signing in again (8 emails)
- [sign_in, bug] Sign-in screen does not appear, or the app stalls before it (2 emails)
- [adoption_or_generation, bug] Making a custom pet fails or the result looks wrong (3 emails)
- [home_first_view, bug] Pet does not show on the desktop, or the app will not open (3 emails)
- [after_onboarding, confusion] Unclear how to control, hide or talk to the pet (3 emails)
- [after_onboarding, bug] Desktop features misbehave after setup (4 emails)
- [after_onboarding, account] Requests to delete an account or personal data (4 emails)
- [after_onboarding, payment] Refunds and payment questions (6 emails)
- [after_onboarding, request] Requests for more pets, items or features (4 emails)
- [after_onboarding, other] Empty messages with no description (7 emails)
</support_themes>

Big moves are welcome and expected: redesign whole screens, add new screens or whole new sub-flows,
reorder the journey, rebuild a screen out of new components. Small copy tweaks are fine too, but at least
4 of your ideas must be big moves (kind redesign, new_flow, new_screen or reorder). A separate checker
only makes sure nothing existing is deleted or skipped and nothing outside onboarding changes, so you do not
need to hold back.

Changes already shipped, in order (the current onboarding includes all of them): ['Move sign-in after pet adoption', 'Compact welcome banner with quick start guide', 'Move sign-in after completion waiting']
Changes already tested and stopped: ['Pet preview confirmation screen', 'Post-certificate sign in reorder', 'Story carousel onboarding intro']
Ideas the safeguards blocked (they cannot be tested, do not propose them again): ['Highlight quick preset vs custom paths', 'Card layout for adoption certificate', 'Redesign final screen into interactive launch stage', 'Desktop pet controls tutorial screen', 'Time estimate badges on path choices', 'Photo upload requirement checklist', 'Split-screen pet adoption studio', 'Starter bonus perk badge', 'Grid pet selection layout', 'Pet companion control tutorial screen', 'Certificate preview before photo upload', 'Guided photo upload helper sub-flow', 'Pet trait guidance hint on friend selection', 'Compact layout for adoption certificate screen', 'Interactive pet naming waiting room screen', 'Account pet retrieval explicit hint', 'Welcome reward badge on home intro', 'Pet trait preview sub-flow', 'Desktop display controls onboarding screen', 'Spotlight adoption seal ceremony', 'Photo lighting photo upload hint']

Lessons from earlier weeks (written by you after reading test results):
Sign-in reordering (sign_in, reorder) is helpful, averaging +3.0% after noise correction across 3 tests with 2 winning tests, though 1 test showed no clear effect.
Evidence is still thin for adding new adoption screens (adoption, new_screen) with only 1 test, which showed no clear effect.
Evidence is still thin for path choice redesigns (choose_path, redesign) with only 1 test, which showed no clear effect.
Evidence is still thin for finish redesigns (finish, redesign) with only 1 test, despite it winning.
Predictions are often too high, overestimating actual noise-corrected impact in most tests.
Predictions can sometimes underestimate actual impact, as in round 6 (+1.5% predicted vs +3.1% noise-corrected) and round 7 (+2.2% predicted vs +4.6% noise-corrected).

Propose 10 NEW changes, different from everything above. Each must be testable as a 50/50 test.
Return JSON {"candidates": [{
  "title": short name,
  "target_step": one of ['choose_path', 'sign_in', 'adoption', 'home', 'finish'],
  "type": one of ['copy', 'hint', 'wait_info', 'notification', 'layout', 'incentive', 'reorder', 'new_screen', 'new_flow', 'redesign'],
  "change": what the user sees differently, one or two sentences,
  "why": the evidence from the funnel or the support mail,
  "config": the exact switch for the app, as {screen: {field: value}}.
            Existing screens, in their current order: ['story', 'choose_path', 'sign_in', 'pick_friend', 'upload_photos', 'adoption_certificate', 'waiting', 'home_intro'].
            Fields on any screen: {'headline': 'str max 80', 'body': 'str max 240', 'hint': 'str max 160', 'button_label': 'str max 30', 'layout': 'str', 'show_progress': 'bool', 'show_time_estimate': 'bool', 'notify_when_ready': 'bool', 'show_step_counter': 'bool', 'tip_delay_seconds': 'int max 60', 'components': 'list max 12', 'replace': 'dict'}. "layout" is one of ['card', 'carousel', 'centered', 'checklist', 'compact', 'default', 'full_bleed', 'grid', 'list', 'split', 'spotlight', 'stage', 'story_scroll', 'two_column'].
            "components" is a list of new elements added to the screen, each {"type": one of ['animation', 'badge', 'button', 'checklist', 'choice_cards', 'image', 'mascot', 'name_input', 'photo_picker', 'preview', 'progress', 'sound', 'text', 'timer', 'tip_carousel', 'video'],
            "text", "label", "asset": "asset:<id>", "style": one of ['calm', 'emphasis', 'highlight', 'large', 'plain', 'playful', 'rounded', 'small', 'subtle'], "action": one of ['back', 'choose', 'next', 'open_tip', 'play', 'replay']}.
            Components are added on top of the screen's existing design.
            "replace" swaps out part of an existing screen for something better that does the same job:
            {"<part>": [components, each with "role": "<part>"]}. Parts per screen: {'story': ['intro_story', 'settings_entry'], 'choose_path': ['path_options', 'settings_entry'], 'sign_in': ['sign_in_options', 'settings_entry'], 'pick_friend': ['pet_choices', 'settings_entry'], 'upload_photos': ['photo_upload', 'settings_entry'], 'adoption_certificate': ['certificate', 'official_stamp', 'settings_entry'], 'waiting': ['wait_status', 'settings_entry'], 'home_intro': ['home_welcome', 'settings_entry']}.
            Add screens by naming them new_<something> (up to 8, at most 3 in a row).
            Change the order with "_order": the full list of screens, including any new ones; existing screens
            keep their order, except sign_in, which may move later.
            A change may only edit the existing screens of its own target step: {'choose_path': ['choose_path', 'story'], 'sign_in': ['sign_in'], 'adoption': ['adoption_certificate', 'pick_friend', 'upload_photos'], 'home': ['waiting'], 'finish': ['home_intro']}.
            Nothing on the sign_in screen may lead past it without signing in.
            If your idea needs something outside onboarding, or removing or skipping a step, still
            list it, with "config": {} and say in "change" what it would need. The checker will decide.
}]}

candidates.title: Move sign-in to final step after home intro
candidates.change: Move the sign-in step to the very end of onboarding after the home intro, allowing users to experience pet setup friction-free before account creation.
candidates.why: Adoption conversion drops to 60.9% and early account creation adds unnecessary friction before users see value.

candidates.title: Pet care pledge screen
candidates.change: Insert a short pet care pledge screen right before the adoption certificate to build excitement and emotional commitment.
candidates.why: The adoption step has the lowest completion rate (60.9%) and taking 89s median / 1017s mean time.

adoption_certificate.hint: Confirm your commitment to caring for your new desktop pet.

candidates.title: Path selection quiz flow
candidates.change: Insert an interactive quiz screen before path selection to help users decide which pet path suits them best.
candidates.why: 23.8% of users drop off at choose_path with a wide gap between median (8s) and mean (514s) time, indicating indecision.

choose_path.headline: Find Your Creation Path
choose_path.body: Answer a few quick questions to match with the best creation path.

candidates.title: Two column home intro overview
candidates.change: Redesign the home intro finish screen into a clear two-column layout highlighting essential pet controls and desktop shortcuts.
candidates.why: 29% drop-off at finish screen (mean time 5815s) and support emails show confusion on how to control or hide pets.

home_intro.headline: Meet Your Desktop Companion
home_intro.body: Your pet is now active! Here is how to control, interact, and manage your pet.

components.text: Click pet to open options menu
Drag pet to relocate on screen

candidates.title: Photo quality setup hint
candidates.change: Add an explicit photo lighting and format tip on the photo upload screen.
candidates.why: 3 support tickets reported custom pet generation failing or rendering wrong imagery.

upload_photos.hint: For best pet rendering results, upload clear, well-lit photos with full face visibility.

candidates.title: Generation progress timer and tips
candidates.change: Add a visual completion timer and tip carousel component to the waiting screen while pet assets generate.
candidates.why: Home waiting screen has high mean wait duration (2336s) causing users to assume the app stalled.

waiting.headline: Creating Your Desktop Pet
waiting.body: We are generating your custom desktop animations. This will take just a moment!

components.text: Tip: You can customize pet behavior anytime from your desktop taskbar.

candidates.title: Account pet recovery explicit reassurance
candidates.change: Update sign-in headline and body text to clearly explain that signing in saves and secures pet data across reinstalls.
candidates.why: 8 support emails complained about pets missing or resetting after signing in again.

sign_in.headline: Secure Your Pet Data
sign_in.body: Signing in syncs your companion safe to the cloud so your pet is never reset or lost when re-installing.

candidates.title: Story scroll intro layout
candidates.change: Change the story screen layout to story_scroll for an engaging visual intro before choosing a creation path.
candidates.why: 76.2% conversion on path selection leaves room for improvement by visually framing expectations early.

story.headline: Welcome to Desktop Companions
story.body: Scroll through to see how interactive desktop pets bring your screen to life.

candidates.title: Official pet parent adoption badge
candidates.change: Display an official pet parent reward badge on the adoption certificate screen upon completing pet customization.
candidates.why: Adoption has a 39.1% drop-off; positive visual milestones increase completion motivation.

adoption_certificate.headline: Official Pet Adoption Certificate
adoption_certificate.body: Congratulations on completing your companion setup!

candidates.title: Desktop updates ready notification
candidates.change: Enable optional desktop notifications on the final home intro screen to keep users informed when features update.
candidates.why: 4 support emails reported desktop feature misbehavior post-setup; notifications help communicate fixes and tips.

home_intro.hint: Enable desktop updates to receive new pet interaction guides and companion features.
